message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather. The average high is around **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to about **48 °F (9 °C)**. Overall, the average daily temperature hovers near **58 °F (14 °C)**. These figures can vary slightly from year to year, but they give a good sense of the typical December climate in LA.
